main_body: A flat green grass-like ground patch (named 'desert') tiled across 4x3 tiles; terrain texture only, no standing volume
top_band: none (flat terrain texture; the column scan shows only repeating green speckle runs, no top band or front face)
evidence: Terrain tile: a seamless ground texture with no standing object, so the 3/4 top-and-front contract does not apply. It reads as a flat ground surface, which is correct for the terrain kind. Nothing is drawn as a front elevation, side elevation or slab.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours (median 5 per tile) against the grass reference's 80 colours and 26 per tile. It uses a regularly repeating speckle of dark and light dots on a mid-green base. The pattern tiles visibly, with the same clumps recurring every 8 or 16px, so it reads as a mechanical stamp rather than hand-shaded grass. It has no flat 5x5 fills, but the 5-step ramp is thin and the variation is sparse. Paving has 7 colours, but that is a different material, and grass is the closest reference. The name 'desert' also does not match the green grass look, though hue is not judged. Density is far below the grass reference, so it fails.
